name: The Call of Phi Pa Mum
content: [1] Getting the item First you need to locate the house where the item is located. The coordinates are 203,138 at the House of Prayers. Use the stairs outside to get to the second floor. Open the door to get into the quest room. If the door is locked, the player can jump from ledge to ledge as shown in the photo. Then you need to climb the window and pick up the little book which is laying on the ground, next to a pentacle of candles. [2] Delivering the item Now you need to get to a safe point like a friendly or neutral outpost or your Home Base to deliver the item to Artisan . 203, 148 is the house located at House of Prayers. You need to go to upstairs. Follow the stairs to the second floor, then use the door to get in the room. If the door is locked, you need to jump from Ledge to ledge. then vault to the window. Pick up the little Weird Book on the floor.
